title: theta-resonance + epi-sigillin + hikari-ledger + diffusive-routing: Brain Oscillation Bands, Epigenetic Runtime Parameter Mutation, Proof-of-Resonance Consensus & Entropy-Minimizing Network Routing (GenesisAeon Packages 27–30)
description: Packages 27, 28, 29, and 30 of the GenesisAeon Entropy Atlas. Package 27 (theta-resonance): models EEG frequency bands (delta/theta/alpha/beta/gamma) as CREP modulation channels within the UTAC framework. Confirms Γ_theta ≈ 0.251 = Γ_AMOC = Γ_neural_criticality — the triple homeostatic universality prediction. Package 28 (epi-sigillin): implements epigenetic mutation of UTAC/CREP parameters during runtime — high entropy epochs methylate (suppress) CREP-P, low entropy epochs de-methylate (activate) CREP-E. Package 29 (hikari-ledger): implements Proof-of-Resonance (PoR) consensus for distributed genesis-os node networks. Nodes with high CREP earn validation rights proportional to Γ; blocks accepted when weighted agreement > 2/3. Γ_PoR ≈ 0.367. Includes HikariCurrencyMinter (ΔH_i = k·Γ_i·(1−S_H)), BFT fallback, and full Diamond-Template contract. Package 30 (diffusive-routing): implements entropy-minimizing network routing where packets flow along paths of minimum entropic resistance ρ_ij = baseline/(1+Γ_ij·coherence), analogous to gas in low-pressure regions. The resistance field evolves via Turing reaction-diffusion; the S_A/S_V entropy duality provides the variational routing objective. Γ_routing ≈ 0.443 (η = 0.75, σ = 2.2). All packages implement: run_cycle / get_crep_state / get_utac_state / get_phase_events / to_zenodo_record.
